screening_log.quote: In this randomised trial, 180 patients with septic acute kidney injury received an NLRP3 inhibitor or placebo.
In a prospective cohort of 96 patients with sepsis, higher urinary NLRP3 was associated with slower renal recovery, but there was no significant difference in dialysis-free survival.
